blocks.text: A playful drinking-game song built around the Korean party game 'Apartment', mixing K-pop and Bruno Mars' retro-pop style.

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 1
items: Boy, you make me feel so good
I don't wanna stop, I think we should
Keep playing this game all night
You and me, we got this right

blocks.heading: 🎤 Refrain (Chorus)
items: A-P-T, apartment
That's where I wanna be
With you, just you and me
Playing A-P-T

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 2
items: Pour another round tonight
We're doing fine, we're feeling right
Don't want this moment to end
Stay here with me, my friend

blocks.heading: 🎵 Bridge
items: Every time we play this game
Nothing ever feels the same
You got me under your spell
And that feeling I know so well

blocks.text: An emotional power ballad about finding joy and love even in the darkest moments — written and recorded in a single night.

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 1
items: I wake up in the middle of the night
And everything is alright
As long as I'm holding you
Nothing can go wrong

blocks.heading: 🎤 Chorus
items: If the world was ending
I'd want to be next to you
If the skies are falling down
I know that your love is true
And I, I don't wanna die
I just wanna die with a smile

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 2
items: I've been running from my fears
For what feels like a million years
But every time I look at you
I know just what I'm fighting for

blocks.heading: 🎵 Bridge
items: So hold my hand, don't let me go
Together we will face it all
And when it's our time to leave
We'll go out in a blaze of love

blocks.text: A witty, self-confident pop song about being irresistibly addictive — like a shot of espresso. Summer anthem of 2024.

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 1
items: I can't relate to desperation
No, my give-a-damn's vacating
And I just need some sweet sensation
Some stimulation, some new temptation

blocks.heading: 🎤 Chorus
items: That's that me espresso
And I'm bored — call it making moves
I'm that girl, I'm that girl
He said he can't stop thinking about me
I guess I'm just that girl

blocks.heading: 🎵 Verse 2
items: I'm too busy for your love games
Got my own thing in the fast lane
You're just another new flame
But I like you, you're not the same

blocks.heading: 🎵 Bridge
items: Said you can't stop thinking about me
I guess I'm just that girl
Guess I make it look easy
Being this unforgettable
